meta_title: Hot Haus Heating & Plumbing | Plumber Liverpool
meta_description: Hot Haus Heating & Plumbing offer expert plumbing and heating services across Liverpool. Gas Safe registered, fast response, free quotes. Call us today.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Liverpool's Trusted Heating & Plumbing Specialists
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdowns, leaks, or no hot water — Hot Haus is on hand fast, fixing it right first time.
services_heading: Complete Heating & Plumbing Services Across Liverpool
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full bathroom installations, we cover every heating and plumbing need for Liverpool homeowners and landlords.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Servicing
services.desc: Fast diagnosis and repair of all boiler makes and models, keeping your home warm and your energy bills in check. Annual servicing also available to maintain efficiency and extend boiler life.

services.title: Boiler Installations
services.desc: Supply and installation of A-rated combi, system, and conventional boilers from leading brands. We advise on the best unit for your home and handle the full installation to Gas Safe standards.

services.title: Central Heating
services.desc: Full central heating system installations, power flushing, and radiator upgrades to improve heat distribution throughout your home. We also fit thermostatic radiator valves and smart heating controls.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, severe leaks, or no hot water — we respond quickly across Liverpool to prevent damage and restore your water supply as soon as possible.

services.title: Bathroom Installations
services.desc: Full bathroom and en-suite fitting services, from removing the old suite to tiling, plumbing, and final snagging. We work tidily and leave your new bathroom ready to enjoy.

services.title: Landlord Gas Safety Certificates
services.desc: CP12 gas safety inspections and certificates for landlords, ensuring your rental property meets legal requirements. We work around tenants and turn certificates around promptly.

about_pullquote: Every job matters — we treat your home exactly as we'd treat our own.
about_para_1: Hot Haus Heating & Plumbing was founded right here in Liverpool by local engineers who wanted to offer a genuinely reliable, no-nonsense heating and plumbing service to their community. Based on Mather Avenue in L18, we serve homeowners and landlords across the city and surrounding areas, bringing professional Gas Safe expertise to every job.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation on honest pricing, tidy workmanship, and showing up when we say we will — qualities that keep our customers coming back and recommending us to friends and neighbours. Whether it's a routine boiler service or an urgent callout, you'll always deal with a qualified engineer who takes pride in the work.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Hot Haus

reviews.text: Boiler packed in on a cold morning and Hot Haus had an engineer out to us the same day. Really professional, explained everything clearly, and the price was fair. Brilliant service — would highly recommend to anyone in Liverpool.
reviews.author: Claire B.

reviews.text: Used Hot Haus for a full bathroom refit and couldn't be happier. The guys were tidy, on time every day, and the finish is excellent. Already booked them in to service the boiler next month.
reviews.author: James W.

reviews.text: Had a leak under the kitchen sink causing real damage. Called Hot Haus and they were round within a couple of hours. Sorted it quickly and at a very reasonable cost. Great local firm — save their number!
reviews.author: Donna M.
